name: Amulet of Obtenebration
body:
This elaborate silver amulet always appears to be in shadow, no matter the angle it is held in.

Aura faint evocation [darkness]; CL 3rd; Slot neck; Price 12,000 gp; Weight —

DESCRIPTION

While worn, this amulet provides the wearer with a continuous protective penumbra effect, wreathing the wearer in shadows no matter the level of light. This item is heavily sought after by creatures with vulnerability to light such as vampires.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Craft Wondrous Item, protective penumbra, then miscellaneous; Cost xx,xxx gp.
